# Ubuntu Mono

- Files used: UbuntuMono-Regular.ttf and UbuntuMono-Bold.ttf, unmodified.
- Copyright 2011 Canonical Ltd. Licensed under the Ubuntu Font Licence 1.0 (see UFL.txt).
- Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ufl/ubuntumono
- The files are renamed to `ubuntu_mono_regular.ttf` and `ubuntu_mono_bold.ttf` in
  `core/ui/src/main/res/font/` only because Android resource names must be lowercase.
- A copy of the licence also ships inside the app at `assets/licenses/ubuntu-mono-UFL.txt`.
